summary: Mesoblast filed a Form 6-K furnishing an ASX press release dated September 24, 2026, disclosing FDA approval of a new potency assay, the T-cell Proliferation Inhibition BioAssay (TIBA), for release and stability monitoring of new commercial Ryoncil lots. TIBA joins existing IL-2R inhibition and Cell Adhesion and Proliferation assays in a release matrix under the product's Biologics License. No stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or transaction mechanics are stated. This is a routine regulatory/manufacturing quality update, not a special situation; watch assay validation and any batch release delays, not deal terms.
